name: bundle-advanced
title: Large multi-library plain-JS bundle, ADVANCED
description: Eleven UMD/script library builds compiled together in `ADVANCED` mode with source map output (5.4 MB input): three.js r159 `build/three.js`, lodash 4.17.21 `lodash.js`, react-dom 18.3.1 `umd/react-dom.development.js`, rxjs 7.8.2 `dist/bundles/rxjs.umd.js`, d3 7.9.0 `dist/d3.js`, moment 2.31.0 `min/moment-with-locales.js`, vue 2.7.16 `dist/vue.js`, jquery 3.7.1 `dist/jquery.js`, handlebars 4.7.10 `dist/handlebars.js`, immutable 5.1.9 `dist/immutable.js`, and underscore 1.13.8 `underscore-umd.js`. `--jscomp_warning=checkVars` demotes undeclared UMD/WebXR globals (`require`, `define`, `XRWebGLLayer`, `XRWebGLBinding`) from error to warning so the full `ADVANCED` optimization and renaming pipeline runs to completion.
